official_sources.title: Practice guide 40 supplement 4 boundary agreements and determined boundaries

verified_contracts: most registered titles show general boundaries
general boundaries have no standard tolerance measurement or ratio to the legal boundary
title plans provide a graphic representation of the general extent of registered land
all title plans show general boundaries unless a line is determined under section 60
a determined boundary records an exact line only after that line has been identified
HM Land Registry does not resolve a boundary dispute through the determination process
the property register records that a boundary is determined
a filed determined-boundary plan is retained for identifying the exact line
public title-plan or INSPIRE geometry must not be promoted to a surveyed legal boundary without evidence
candidate binding remains blocked without current title-specific polygon bytes or determined-boundary evidence
